per_task_type_budgets._comment: Token budgets per task type. Treat as ceilings, not targets. Tune via eval-harness category 2.

per_section_budgets._comment: Per-section token caps within a pack. Truncation rule applies on overrun (see truncation_rule below).

truncation_rule._comment: When per_section budget is exceeded, apply one of: head_plus_tail | evidence_anchored | fail_pack
truncation_rule.marker_text: [truncated <bytes_omitted> bytes — see source <path> at <sha256> for full]

required_sources_per_task_type._comment: Sections that must appear in every pack for the named task type. Missing → NEEDS_USER for context-gathering re-do.

trust_tier_precedence._comment: Higher number wins on conflict. Within same tier, newest fresh_at wins. Tie → NEEDS_USER per agent-safety-constitution.

drift_staleness_days._comment: If a referenced source has not been re-fetched/re-confirmed in N days, surface a freshness warning. Per-tier defaults.

quality_scoring._enabled_note: Phase 5 turns this on when score-context-pack.js ships. Today the score is design-target only.

drift_detection._enabled_note: Phase 5 turns this on when detect-context-drift.js ships. Today SHA recording is design-target only.

playbook_abstraction._enabled_note: Phase 5 introduces `reference/playbooks/<task-type>.md` files updated by score-run-quality.js outputs.

gbrain_hits_section._enabled_note: Gated by gbrain-import-policy.json#context_pack_integration (also false). Phase 5 turns both on after eval-harness category 2 baseline.

kill_switch._note: build-context-pack.js exits 0 silent when DISABLED; this policy is moot in that state.
